# sharqey_sso (Resource)

An SSO connection (SAML or generic OIDC) for a Sharqey organization. One connection per organization — applying this resource replaces any existing connection for that organization. Requires org-admin+ role.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Root path (slug) of the organization this connection belongs to, e.g. "acme". Organizations are created outside Terraform (web UI).
- `protocol` (String) "oidc" or "saml". The server validates protocol-specific required fields on apply.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this connection is active for login. Defaults to the value last applied; set explicitly to avoid surprises.
- `oidc_client_id` (String) Required for protocol="oidc".
- `oidc_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Required for protocol="oidc". The server never returns this back — Terraform can't detect out-of-band drift on it, only config changes trigger a re-apply.
- `oidc_issuer_url` (String) Required for protocol="oidc".
- `saml_idp_certificate` (String, Sensitive) Required for protocol="saml". PEM X.509 certificate. The server never returns this back — same drift caveat as oidc_client_secret.
- `saml_idp_entity_id` (String) Required for protocol="saml".
- `saml_idp_sso_url` (String) Required for protocol="saml".
- `sso_only` (Boolean) Requires SSO for NEW joins to this organization (invites still allow per-invite opt-out). Does not affect existing members' ability to log in with a password.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the organization — one connection per organization.
- `oidc_redirect_uri` (String) This Sharqey instance's OIDC redirect URI — paste into the IdP's OAuth client config.
- `sp_acs_url` (String) This Sharqey instance's SAML ACS URL for this organization — paste into the IdP.
- `sp_entity_id` (String) This Sharqey instance's SAML SP entity ID for this organization — paste into the IdP.
